title: Braintrust
prompt:
Build the SEO content strategy for Braintrust.

Braintrust (braintrust.dev) is an LLM evaluation and observability platform for teams shipping AI products. Three jobs: Observe - trace prompts, responses and tool calls in production; Evaluate - run experiments against versioned datasets and score outputs with code, LLM judges or humans; Discover - cluster traces to find failure patterns and gate bad releases before they ship.

The buyer is a software engineer, AI/ML engineer or engineering manager at a company with an LLM feature already in production, who currently checks quality by eyeballing outputs and cannot tell whether a prompt or model change made things better or worse. Named customers include Notion, Vercel, Replit, Cloudflare, Coursera and Box.

IMPORTANT - this is braintrust.dev, the LLM eval platform. It is NOT usebraintrust.com, the freelance talent marketplace. Ignore anything about hiring, freelancers, talent networks or recruiting.

Website: https://www.braintrust.dev/
Our blog: https://www.braintrust.dev/blog
Docs: https://www.braintrust.dev/docs

Competitors:
- https://langfuse.com/
- https://www.langchain.com/langsmith
- https://wandb.ai/site/weave
- https://arize.com/
- https://humanloop.com/
- https://www.galileo.ai/
- https://www.confident-ai.com/
- https://www.helicone.ai/

Market: United States, English.

Not going after: "what is an LLM" explainers, prompt-engineering tips, or generic AI-news content. This audience already builds with these models. Focus on evaluation, observability, and the decisions engineers make when shipping and debugging AI features.

artifact.notes: Seeds target advanced teams shipping production AI agents: tracing complex executions, testing prompt/model changes, detecting quality failures, and preventing regressions. Site seeds are directly grounded in on-page language around traces, datasets, scoring, regressions, and quality gates.

summary:
The brief is complete for US-English search. The validation gate approved the strategy, and the relevance gate confirmed business fit. Four clusters were selected: evaluation methods, quality measurement, observability software, and evaluation software.

Build the LLM evaluation methods guide first: it offers 2,260 total monthly searches at 16.2 average difficulty. Prioritize the observability comparison next because 83% of its terms have commercial intent, despite lower demand and higher difficulty. Braintrust must out-answer Confident AI, Arize, Galileo, Datadog, ACM, Patronus AI, SuperAnnotate, and Reddit.

The recommended pillars are the evaluation-methods guide, AI observability platform comparison, and LLM/RAG metrics hub. Each article should use the specified question as a heading and answer it directly in the first two sentences so search and answer engines can quote it. Use blog posts for technical questions; add dedicated category/comparison pages for commercial searches. Generic MCP, agent architecture, RAG architecture, structured outputs, and recruiting meanings were excluded.

The brief said it is NOT usebraintrust.com (the talent marketplace), so that domain was ruled out, not researched.
